notes: Forge's success path has exactly one `try? FileManager.default.removeItem` call (line 358), for the installer jar. There is no `installer.log` removal anywhere in `ForgeInstaller` -- unlike `NeoForgeInstaller.install`, which removes both (see neoforge-installer-cleanup-removes-jar-and-installer-log). Both installers' `try?` swallows a failed removal silently either way; that failure path isn't in MSC 1's own tests and isn't a Phase 7 characterization target.
